request.objective: Start at https://us.megabus.com/. Find out what to do when I lose an item on a bus on us.megabus.

response.result:
Megabus’s FAQ says to report an item lost on a bus to its Lost and Found department by completing the linked lost-item inquiry form. The information is entered into their system for investigation; a response may take several days. Megabus says it will try to return the item and help with retrieval as best it can.

The linked page is Contact Us, which offers chat with virtual assistant Chuck or email at [email]. Chuck can connect you with a customer-service representative if he can’t answer. The contact page did not show a separate lost-item form.
